text:
mira: Heads up - customer on prod saw console query results show rows from two different orgs after rapidly switching workspaces. Repro in ~2s on my laptop.

sam: :eyes: can you paste repro steps?

mira: Steps:
1) open /console/insights
2) switch org via top-left quick-switch twice within <300ms
3) refresh list -> see mixed rows

mira: Quick log snippet:
```
GET /api/internal/query?view=insights 200
Headers: x-org-id: 645 -> then 123
Cached response key: prefetch:insights:645
Served with cached-body for request org 123
```

jon: That looks like prefetch cache key missing org scoping. Which PR touched prefetch?

anya: PR #4879 (org-prefetch-optimization) changed cache key from `prefetch:${view}:${tenant}` -> `prefetch:${view}` and moved header injection to edge sidecar. Might've accidentally removed org tag.

infra-bot: deploy:staging completed for job prefetch-service/sha@b1f5

mira: We didn't see in staging; customer hit on prod because they use extremely fast org switching. Maybe a race in header propagation to sidecar.

kevin: Quick mitigation: disable prefetch via feature flag for console route. Flipping now.

deploy-bot: feature-flag `console_prefetch` set to OFF in prod by kevin @ 1719456240 :white_check_mark:

sam: Can we repro with curl? Mira, can you drop the exact curl sequence?

mira: sure:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "x-org-id:645" https://console.redwood.ai/api/internal/query?view=insights
# immediately
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "x-org-id:123" https://console.redwood.ai/api/internal/query?view=insights
```

mira: watch server logs for `Served with cached-body` line

jon: Looks like two issues: 1) cache key missing org id 2) sidecar request header reuse when requests arrive IMMEDIATELY after each other (connection reuse race). Both need fixes.

anya: For 1) quick fix: include tenant id in cache key: `prefetch:${view}:${tenant}`. For 2) add request-scoped header clearing in sidecar (PR incoming).

alex: internal-api debate: do we rely on `x-org-id` header for routing or use auth token -> token->org mapping? Using header is faster but brittle. Thoughts?

kevin: we argued this last quarter. For web console, header is acceptable but must be enforced at ingress. We need tests.

jon: I'll own patch to change cache key + add unit tests. Anya will patch sidecar to clear per-request headers. Jon -> PR #4891. Anya -> PR #4892.

mira: created bug INF-8723 with logs + waterfall screenshot: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-8723

kevin: Also add a telemetry spike alert: query cache hit ratio by tenant + anomalous mixed-org rows detection.

infra-bot: oncall ping @oncall-platform

oncall-platform: Looking.

oncall-platform: Confirmed feature flag flip removed incidents from prod stream. Repro locally with timing harness.

sam: Plan for tomorrow: rollback or canary patch? We already toggled flag. Recommend patch + canary in prod with 1% traffic, monitor `mixed_org_rows` metric.

jon: PR #4891 opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/prefetch-service/pull/4891

anya: PR #4892 opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sidecar/pull/4892

mira: thx everyone. I'll follow up with customer and add repro steps to INF-8723. :thumbsup:

kevin: good triage. postmortem only if we see recurrence. closing thread for now.
